title: CMDB host CSV import and export
goal: Add Excel-compatible CSV import, template download, and scoped asset export to business/cmdb host management by reusing pantheon-base import/export contracts.

in: CMDB host export, import template, and transactional import backend flow
business/cmdb host import and export permissions, menu seeds, runtime i18n, and tests
CMDB host list utility actions using shared frontend import/export components
business overlay, backend, frontend, and CMDB runtime verification
out: unrelated dirty-tree business, system, or platform changes

implementationNotes: Landing side remains pantheon-ops because the change is confined to the business/cmdb host slice.
The minimum viable approach reuses pkg/impexp CSVFile, WriteCSV, ReadCSV, ImportResult, and shared frontend import/export utilities.
CSV remains the repository-wide Excel-compatible format; no new dependency is introduced.

runtimeEvidence: CMDB business smoke screenshots at desktop and mobile viewports when the local runtime is available
explicit runtime gap if database-backed smoke cannot start

evidenceRequired: backend build and CMDB package test output
frontend type-check, lint, and production build output
rendered CMDB host-list evidence or an explicit runtime gap
completionChecklist: backend and frontend import/export flow implemented
targeted tests and repository gates recorded
